samples.detection_method: Implement email gateway filtering to flag emails failing SPF and DMARC checks especially from newly registered domains with homoglyph substitutions (e.g., 'payr0ll' instead of 'payroll'). Use sandboxing to analyze URLs and form submission behavior. Correlate domain registration dates with phishing campaigns. Monitor HTTP POST requests to unknown domains collecting credential-like parameters. Conduct user awareness training focusing on payroll phishing tactics.
